candidates.hypothesis: A complete tracked-file and directory inventory plus bounded standard-path negatives recovers explicit topology without inference.
candidates.expected_benefit: high detection recall with exact path evidence
candidates.false_claim_risk: low; every claim is revalidated against the filesystem
candidates.cost_latency: one git ls-files call plus bounded path/glob checks
candidates.determinism_characteristics: sorted Git/file observations; no network, clock, or model

candidates.hypothesis: Recursive parsing of bounded JSON and runtime manifests recovers product identity and declared build/runtime facts more precisely than filename catalogues.
candidates.inference_introduced: none; structured scalar values and literal manifest lines only
candidates.expected_benefit: high precision for identity, version, runtime, and command claims
candidates.false_claim_risk: low; malformed or oversized documents are skipped rather than guessed
candidates.cost_latency: bounded parse of tracked JSON and standard runtime manifests
candidates.determinism_characteristics: sorted paths and pointers; no network, clock, or model

candidates.hypothesis: Explicit path references in governing and introductory documents can reconstruct authority/document relationships without semantic guesswork.
candidates.inference_introduced: bounded relationship: a literal path reference means references, not governs
candidates.expected_benefit: recovers governance hierarchy while preserving unknown authority when no accepted root exists
candidates.false_claim_risk: low; relationship vocabulary is limited to literal references
candidates.cost_latency: bounded reads of root governance and README documents
candidates.determinism_characteristics: literal token extraction and sorted edges; no network, clock, or model

candidates.hypothesis: Staging topology observation, structured parsing, and literal governance relationships yields broad coverage while keeping every conclusion evidence-bound.
candidates.inference_introduced: none beyond the explicit references relation
candidates.expected_benefit: best evidence coverage across heterogeneous repositories without strengthening claims
candidates.false_claim_risk: low but broader blast radius; invalid emitted claims are counted as false certainty
candidates.cost_latency: sum of the three bounded deterministic stages
candidates.determinism_characteristics: deduplicated canonical claim order; no network, clock, or model
